messages:
Maya R.: Starting NovoHealth POC checklist. They asked for dev-scoped hosted API keys, audit export to their S3 with CMK, and a Dedicated pool ballpark. Need answers for security questionnaire items about audit retention and prompt redaction.

Oliver (NovoHealth): Hi! Confirming: 1) Dev API key limited to our workspace 2) Audit to S3 (12 months) w/ KMS 3) Can you provide sample audit schema and sample bucket policy? Timeline: want logs flowing within 72 hours.

Priya (Security): We can enable S3 export to customer-owned buckets. Default retention policy is configurable; for POCs set to 365 days. Prompts are redacted unless customer signs NDA and requests full-text export. We'll provide audit_schema.json and redaction_guidelines. For CMKs, we can accept customer-owned KMS key ARN or use our envelope encryption; customer-owned is preferred.

Tom - Infra: Dedicated sizing note: for light load (<=50 rps, avg 200 tokens) a 2-GPU pool is sufficient. Provisional POC price ~ $5k/mo in us-west. Dedicated takes 3 business days to provision post-contract. Hosted + S3 export can be smoke-tested sooner.

Sara (SRE): Practical steps: 1) Customer creates S3 bucket and adds our service principal in bucket policy (we'll provide sample) 2) Share bucket ARN and KMS key ARN with us 3) We create export config and run a smoke test. I can own the ticket.

Maya R.: Priya—what artifacts do we attach to the security questionnaire? They asked for "evidence of encryption in transit & at rest, key rotation, audit log fields, and access control for API keys."

Priya (Security): We'll provide: - audit_schema.json example - redaction policy doc - encryption statement (TLS in transit + SSE-KMS) - key rotation guidance and console screenshot for rotating scoped API keys - link to SOC2 summary and process contact for full pack under MSA. I'll upload docs to this thread.

Tom - Infra: Sample bucket policy (send to customer): allow PutObject for arn:aws:iam::REDWOOD:role/log-writer with condition on prefix and encryption. Also sample curl to create export config:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/log-exports \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"customer_id":"novohealth","dest":{"type":"s3","bucket_arn":"arn:aws:s3:::novohealth-redwood","kms_key_arn":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:999999:key/xyz"},"format":"jsonl","retention_days":365}'
```
Note: customer must add bucket policy to allow PUTs from our principal.

ops-bot: Created support ticket #POC-4421 assigned to Sara (SRE) for NovoHealth S3 export.

Oliver (NovoHealth): Thanks—sending bucket ARN + CMK via secure portal now. We'll hold prompt export until NDA is finalized. Looking forward to the smoke test.
